I wanted to provide my reasoning here as I had this written up with AI and I think it didn't make things as clear as I was trying to convey them.

I think I can explain myself better. It's regarding ensuring that there is no grey area in group public or group+ instances. I think people are unsure when it comes to 18+ tagged instances as to what this really means content wise. At a basic level this seems to mean people have had their ID verified and they are over 18. Explicit content should be tagged outside of this for clarity when joining an instance or group that may have explicit content. I think this would avoid confusion as I've seen a lot of discussion on what 18+ instances really mean.

There are situations where nudity may not be sexually suggestive but would be considered natural. The 18+ by itself lacks context as to if the instance will contain this type of nudity. I think some type of tag will remove confusions such as Explicit/NSFW

details:
Hi VRChat Team,

I wanted to suggest making an "NSFW" tag optional for 18+ instances and groups, both public and private, that contain explicit content, nudity, or sexual material. While the 18+ verification ensures users are of age, there’s currently no easy way to know if an instance or group will contain explicit content until you enter it.

While avatar-level filtering already allows users to avoid sexually explicit avatars, there’s still a gap in group and instance-level filtering. Many users seek 18+ spaces that allow for adult themes or mature conversations, but without explicit sexual content or sexually suggestive behavior. For example, users may want to engage in spaces with naked avatars that don’t act in a sexually suggestive manner. According to VRChat’s policies, artistic nudity is allowed in private spaces where all participants consent, but explicit sexual content is prohibited. However, this can create a grey area, as some users might consider certain nudity as artistic rather than sexual. An NSFW tag on public instances would help make it clearer for users who are unsure about whether nudity or other content is explicit or artistic.

If group and instance creators had the option to tag their spaces as NSFW or Explicit, it would provide users with a clearer understanding of the type of content present, allowing them to make informed decisions about whether to enter. This would ensure that spaces containing nudity, which some may view as artistic rather than sexually suggestive, are clearly identified, helping to eliminate confusion and make the platform more transparent.

Platforms like Reddit, DeviantArt, and others use "NSFW" tags to help users identify adult content. I believe making this tag optional for creators to use for 18+ spaces would provide better user control and enhance the overall experience.

Is VRChat considering something like this for content tagging and filtering? I think it would help create a safer and more transparent experience for users who want adult spaces but without explicit material.

Thank you for considering this suggestion!
title: Suggestion for Adding an "NSFW" Tag for 18+ Public and Private Instances and Groups
